授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: このコースでは、フーリエ級数と変換について包括的に理解し、その数学的基礎、特性、工学分野での実用的応用に重点を置く。また、信号処理、通信システム、画像解析など、複雑な工学的問題を解決するためにフーリエ解析技術を効果的に応用するために必要な分析・計算能力を身につけ、特に微積分、複素数、線形代数などの数学的能力を強化する。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: The course provide students with a comprehensive understanding of Fourier series and transforms, emphasizing their mathematical foundations, properties, and practical applications in engineering disciplines; equip students with the analytical and computational skills required to effectively apply Fourier analysis techniques to solve complex engineering problems, including those related to signal processing, communication systems, and image analysis; reinforce their mathematical proficiency, particularly in calculus, complex numbers, and linear algebra; and foster critical thinking by challenging students with engineering scenarios that demand the application of Fourier analysis principles.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Fourier analysis, engineering mathematics, frequency domain, signal processing, transforms

授業科目の実施方法について.参考書等:
1. Introduction to Fourier Analysis and Generalized Functions by M. J. Lighthill
2. Fourier Analysis: An Introduction by Elias M. Stein and Rami Shakarchi
3. A First Course in Fourier Analysis by David W. Kammler
4. Fourier Analysis and Its Applications by Gerald B. Folland
5. Principles of Fourier Analysis by Kenneth B. Howell
6. Fourier Analysis by Thomas William Koerner
7. Mathematical methods for students of physics and related fields by Sadri Hassani
8. Advanced Engineering Mathematics by Erwin Kreyszig
9. Fourier Series and Integrals by H. Dym and H. P. McKean
10. An Introduction to Fourier Analysis by Russell L. Herman.
11. Fourier Transforms Principles and Applications by Eric Hansen
